limits: Global custom approximation; source ceiling is after display gamut clipping, not sensor clipping; no Lightroom reference or population quality estimate.

offline_visual_review.scope: All 16 before/v2/v3 comparison sheets at display size
findings: Portraits, snow and tree bark show stronger midtone lifting than v2.
Clipped clouds appear less gray in v3 but missing texture remains absent.
Backlit subjects remain limited by the global adjustment.
No obvious new halos at display size; pixel-level noise and faithful Lightroom comparison not evaluated.
offline_visual_review.decision: Adopt v3 as an approximate global preview; retain v2 source and regression artifacts.
